description: Answers 'what's the weather (on Saturday / tomorrow / the 12th / this weekend / next week)' from met.no's daily forecast (6 days), and opens the weather on the screen that heard it (overlook_show event). Added 2026-11-06 for the bedroom Echo's voice control. Opens the weather page on the screen in the asking satellite's area (writes input_text.overlook_voice; card option voice).

command: (what's|whats|what is|how's|hows|how is) the weather [going to be] [like]
(what's|whats|what is|how's|hows|how is) the weather [going to be] [like] {when}
(what's|whats|what is) it going to be like {when}

variables.days: {% set ns = namespace(o=[]) %}{% for d in fc['weather.forecast_home'].forecast %}{% set t = as_local(as_datetime(d.datetime)) %}{% set ns.o = ns.o + [{'date': t.date() | string, 'dow': t.strftime('%A'), 'dom': t.day, 'cond': d.condition, 'hi': d.temperature | round(0) | int, 'lo': (d.templow if d.templow is defined else d.temperature) | round(0) | int, 'rain': d.precipitation | float(0)}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.o }}
variables.when: {% set ns = namespace(w=(trigger.slots.when if trigger.slots is defined and trigger.slots.when is defined else '') | lower | trim) %}{% for junk in ['going to be like', 'going to be', 'be like', 'like', '?', '.'] %}{% set ns.w = ns.w | replace(junk, ' ') | trim %}{% endfor %}{% for lead in ['on the ', 'for the ', 'on ', 'for ', 'the ', 'this ', 'coming '] %}{% if ns.w.startswith(lead) %}{% set ns.w = ns.w[lead | length:] | trim %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.w }}
variables.pick: {% set ds = days %}{% set today = now().date() | string %}{% set dows = ['monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday','sunday'] %}{% set w = when %}{% set num = w | regex_findall('\d+') %}{% if w in ['', 'today', 'tonight', 'now', 'right now', 'this morning', 'this afternoon', 'this evening'] %}{{ ds | selectattr('date', 'eq', today) | list }}{% elif w in ['tomorrow', 'tomorrow morning', 'tomorrow night', 'tomorrow afternoon'] %}{{ ds | selectattr('date', 'eq', (now() + timedelta(days=1)).date() | string) | list }}{% elif 'weekend' in w %}{{ ds | selectattr('dow', 'in', ['Saturday', 'Sunday']) | list }}{% elif 'week' in w or 'few days' in w or 'days' in w %}{{ ds }}{% elif (w | replace('next ', '')) in dows %}{% set target = (w | replace('next ', '')) %}{% set ahead = (dows.index(target) - now().weekday()) % 7 %}{{ ds | selectattr('date', 'eq', (now() + timedelta(days=ahead)).date() | string) | list }}{% elif num | length > 0 %}{{ ds | selectattr('dom', 'eq', num[0] | int) | list }}{% else %}{{ 'unknown' }}{% endif %}
variables.say: {% macro one(d) %}{{ 'Today' if d.date == (now().date() | string) else ('Tomorrow' if d.date == ((now() + timedelta(days=1)).date() | string) else d.dow) }}: {{ names.get(d.cond, d.cond) }}, {{ d.lo }} to {{ d.hi }} degrees{% if d.rain >= 1 %}, around {{ d.rain | round(0) | int }} millimetres of rain{% elif d.rain >= 0.2 %}, a little rain{% endif %}.{% endmacro %}{% if pick == 'unknown' %}Sorry, I didn't catch which day you meant.{% elif pick | length == 0 %}I only have the forecast up to {{ days[-1].dow }} the {{ days[-1].dom }}{{ 'th' if days[-1].dom in [11,12,13] else {1:'st',2:'nd',3:'rd'}.get(days[-1].dom % 10, 'th') }}.{% else %}{% if when in ['', 'today', 'now', 'right now'] and states('weather.forecast_home') not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] %}It's {{ state_attr('weather.forecast_home', 'temperature') | round(0) | int }} degrees and {{ names.get(states('weather.forecast_home'), states('weather.forecast_home')) }} now. {% endif %}{% for d in pick %}{{ one(d) }} {% endfor %}{% endif %}

data.value: {{ {'area': (area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else ''), 'action': 'weather', 'range': ('week' if pick is not string and pick | length > 1 else 'day'), 'dates': (pick | map(attribute='date') | list if pick is not string else []), 't': now().timestamp() | int} | to_json }}
